name: What is the difference between painting bathroom walls and painting a bathroom vanity?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between painting bathroom walls and painting a bathroom vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting vanity cabinets requires thorough degreasing, scuff sanding, bonding primer, and durable enamel paint, whereas painting bathroom walls focuses on moisture resistance and drywall prep. Because vanity doors and drawer fronts endure constant touching, water splashes, and cleaning products, standard wall paint will chip quickly if applied to cabinetry. As a finish carpentry and remodeling contractor, HH Remodeling handles both scopes. We can repaint your bathroom walls while simultaneously prepping and refinishing your vanity woodwork with durable cabinet-grade finishes for a cohesive, long-lasting update.
acceptedAnswer.description: Walls require moisture-resistant latex finishes, while vanity cabinets require intensive sanding, bonding primer, and hard-curing enamel to prevent chipping.
